description: Replay a committed deterministic test exactly, the same way every time — keyless, no model. Pass ONE of: flowPath or an inline `flow` ({name, app|url, steps:[{tap:X},{type:{field,value}},{wait_for:S},{assert_screen:S},{assert_exists:X},…]}), taskPath (.tapp/tasks/*.yml, compiled then replayed), contractPath (.tapp/contracts/*.contract.ts), or scenarioPath / inline `scenario` (multi-actor, web). A failed assertion fails the run and is reported like a finding. $TEST_EMAIL/$TEST_PASSWORD come from testEmail/testPassword or a configured `actor`. Use tapp_explore to find bugs; use this to prove a fix or guard a regression.

actor.description: Configured actor; resolves $TEST_EMAIL/$TEST_PASSWORD from its env-var bindings

androidAppId.description: Android: application id on a connected emulator/device

apkPath.description: Android: optional APK to install first

appBundleId.description: iOS: bundle id of the installed app

device.description: Web: Playwright device profile. iOS: simulator name or UDID — required when more than one simulator is booted

inputs.description: Task inputs; secrets as $ENV placeholders, never plaintext

journey.description: Name of a journey on a hosted Studio to replay there (with `studio` + `token`, or $TAPP_STUDIO/$TAPP_TOKEN)

studio.description: Hosted Studio origin for `journey`, e.g. https://app.runtapp.com (default $TAPP_STUDIO)

url.description: Web: http(s) URL of an app or environment you own

name: tapp_run
title: Replay a Flow, Task, contract, or Scenario
